Print what each artifact was decided on, and what was decided

Usage: byrle artifact <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show    The latest decision on each artifact named, as JSON Lines: its features and its disposition. Exits 1 when none is recorded
  export  Every decision recorded, oldest first, as JSON Lines
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
